query.description:
Search query - can be either a simple text (e.g. 'project documentation') or a CQL query string. Simple queries use 'siteSearch' by default, to mimic the WebUI search, with an automatic fallback to 'text' search if not supported. Examples of CQL:
- Basic search: 'type=page AND space=DEV'
- Personal space search: 'space="~username"' (note: personal space keys starting with ~ must be quoted)
- Search by title: 'title~"Meeting Notes"'
- Use siteSearch: 'siteSearch ~ "important concept"'
- Use text search: 'text ~ "important concept"'
- Recent content: 'created >= "2023-01-01"'
- Content with specific label: 'label=documentation'
- Recently modified content: 'lastModified > startOfMonth("-1M")'
- Content modified this year: 'creator = currentUser() AND lastModified > startOfYear()'
- Content you contributed to recently: 'contributor = currentUser() AND lastModified > startOfWeek()'
- Content watched by user: 'watcher = "user@domain.com" AND type = page'
- Exact phrase in content: 'text ~ "\"Urgent Review Required\"" AND label = "pending-approval"'
- Title wildcards: 'title ~ "Minutes*" AND (space = "HR" OR space = "Marketing")'
Note: Special identifiers need proper quoting in CQL: personal space keys (e.g., "~username"), reserved words, numeric IDs, and identifiers with special characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return.

space_key.description: Optional space key to list templates defined in that space. When omitted, global templates are returned.

template_id.description: The ID of the template to retrieve.

parent_id.description: Optional ID of the parent page.

space_key.description: Key of the space in which to create the page.

template_id.description: ID of the template to use as the page body.

edit_groups.description: (Optional) Group names allowed to edit the page.

edit_users.description: (Optional) Account IDs (Cloud) or usernames (Server/DC) allowed to edit the page.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to restrict

read_groups.description: (Optional) Group names allowed to view the page.

read_users.description: (Optional) Account IDs (Cloud) or usernames (Server/DC) allowed to view the page. Empty list = unrestricted.

copy_attachments.description: (Optional) Whether to copy attachments to the new page. Defaults to true. Only supported on Confluence Cloud.

destination_parent_id.description: (Optional) Parent page ID in the destination space. When omitted the page is created at the space root.

destination_space_key.description: Space key for the new page (e.g. 'DEV', 'TEAM')

new_title.description: Title for the new copied page

source_page_id.description: The ID of the page to copy

content_id.description: Confluence content ID (page, blog post, comment, or attachment). Example: '123456789'

operation.description: The operation to check. Common values: 'read', 'update', 'delete', 'export', 'purge', 'administer', 'create_or_delete_from_view'.

subject_type.description: Whether the subject is a 'user' or a 'group'. Defaults to 'user'.

user_identifier.description: Account ID of the user (for subject_type='user') or group ID (for subject_type='group'). Example user account ID: '5b10a2844c20165700ede21g'

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of permission entries to return. Defaults to 25.

space_id.description: Numeric ID of the Confluence space. This is the internal space ID, not the space key. Example: '98304'. You can find the space ID from the Confluence REST API (GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces) or from the space URL.
